description: This file defines the CategoryDao interface, which dictates data access operations related to Category entities in the catalog module of the sales manager system. It includes method signatures for retrieving categories based on various attributes like store, lineage, name, code, and URL, among others.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access methods for Category entities.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieve list of categories matching the provided URL for a given store.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Retrieve categories for a store under a specific parent category.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieve categories matching a specific lineage within a store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieve a category by name within a store and language context.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a category using its unique code within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieve all categories belonging to a store.

methods.name: listByStore (with Language parameter)
methods.description: Retrieve categories for a store filtered by language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a category by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Retrieve categories by depth level within a store.

methods.name: listByDepth (with Language parameter)
methods.description: Retrieve categories by depth with language filter.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieve categories matching a lineage code within a store.

methods.name: getByCode (with store code)
methods.description: Retrieve a category by code using store code identifier.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieve a category by its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Retrieve categories with a specific parent category and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Get a category in a specific language by its ID.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Count products associated with a list of categories within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieve categories by a list of codes within a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieve categories by a list of IDs for a store and language.
